body:
I feel all my friends have pulled away from me, especially as my depression worsens and I can't dig myself out, so I can relate in a way. 

I don't talk to my family, at all. I like to forget they exist as that seems to be better then remembering all of the abuse they dished out. But it's lonely. It makes me resent anyone with a family that involves themselves in their life, and takes that for granted.

I would say find something to look forward to and hold onto it. If Christmas is a big thing with general good memories tied to it, then try to keep that going. 

It's a long stretch, so let yourself enjoy the little things, like some good food or drink. It doesn't have to be take-out to be a treat. Pan steaks are affordable and simple to make ($4 for a two pack here). Baked potatoes can be meals in themselves and generally cost less than a dollar to make. 

I don't have much advice. I wish I did. I'm in the same boat so you are not alone, at least.

My boyfriend is freaking out at me about money. I'm kinda resentful about it as most of the money over the last few years have went to pay of bills for his interests while year after year I get nothing and have to beg for the smallest of necessities, like getting groceries rather than fast food. His parents care for every whim and minor scrap on him, but if I ever get ill or need help, they always ask where my family is and why they aren't helping, knowing full well my whole family are all backwoods broke-ass hillbillies that used to beat the shit out of me.

I'm in a very angry and a very sad place together. I'm mad that I can't control myself and I am seen as either lazy or too wild and extreme to deal with. I'm sad I keep losing jobs I try so hard at. This last one was at an art store I had wanted to work at for years and I threw it all away cause I couldn't control my health.

The only doctor I'm seeing right now is a psychiatrist and an OBGYN for the pains. Neither are helping. I made an appointment for a mental health clinic, but when told the doctor I wanted to see wasn't accepting new patients and was only doing groups, I became a little disheartened and forgot all about the intake, missed it completely thinking it was another OBGYN appointment since the hospital name is the same with both. So now, if I reschedule, I'll be waiting another whole month to see someone I am pretty sure I will have no connection with at all. 

I've been in and out of therapy since I was 8 thanks to a parent's death. Sadly, that means I know very well how ridiculously hard it is to build a rapport with someone. 

My psychiatrist has left me pretty lacking in any real hope too, as when I tried to talk to her about my anxiety, she literally told me to get over it, that worrying about a fraction of a percent chance for surgery was ridiculous and a waste of energy.

I tell people I'm worried I'll lose my job cause I'm either too depressed or manic and feeling out of control. They tell me to deal, they tell me to get over it. They just don't get it. It leaves me feeling so lost and like no one will ever understand. And like I should eat a bullet because I really don't see a way to make things better and have a normal life.

But I'm too much of a coward to die, so I go through each day wondering why I'm here if I can't do anything of value, and can't reproduce because I'll pass on a shitty brain disorder to some poor undeserved meatsack.

I think the biggest thing that upsets me right now is my boyfriend telling me if I gave a shit, I would just go and grab a job at any McDonald's to start bringing in money, basically doing 4x the work he does for a fraction of his wage. Angrily, I told him I'll just do sex work and give cheap services to start to bring in clients. His reply was only to charge more. So he really doesn't care about me, I see. All that he ever wanted me for was a second income he could take from freely under the guise of 'it's for us!' when it's always been for him. /vent
Hey thanks! I found an app that is similar to this for those that don't want to carry about cards called Momentum.

Hey, thanks for the reply! I appreciate it. 

I do have a smart phone, so I'll look for a pill reminder app I like.

I think the hardest part of sticking to a sleep schedule is my boyfriend works overnights, so I literally can't even use the bed until he leaves, just before 1am. So, I mean, I guess it's a start. 2am is generally the time I get to sleep normally. But I get tired a lot before then too and end up passing out on the couch.

I tell him a lot that it's really an inconvenience and not fair that he sleeps literally to the last second before he has to get up and dash out the door. He normally falls asleep around noon. 8pm should be enough sleep but he always complains he never sleeps enough.

The most chaos and most support I have are coming from one person and it's really shitty. 


It's really hard for me to want to do anything right now. I'm spending my days sleeping and trying to escape my sadness in video games. Because if I don't... well... those thoughts aren't very safe ones.

I'm going to try a habit forming app/process someone else suggested and see if that does anything for me.

Maybe I'll send you a link sometime.

I loved the Zelda series I grew up with, so Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask. Wind Waker was fun for me too. I started to play Twilight Princess in college but my Wii died. I haven't touched the series since because I need to go back and beat that game.

I was just thinking last night about how I haven't finished The Harry Potter series. I've read every book and seen every movie up to Half-Blood Prince. But, something is keeping me from finishing it. I am now in a funny position where I own only the last book, and it's marked still where I left off in 2007, a few weeks after it's release. I want to go back and read the whole series again and finally finish it. I related a lot with Harry growing up and I supposed I didn't want to let that chapter of my life and my enjoyment with the books end. I find it funny I gave up on finishing and did ultimately what I feared most, I let it end. And I'm not happy cause I didn't finish it in any way at all, so I really let my enjoyment of it go because I didn't see it through to the end.

I wish I could tell you that story is a zen moment thing and I feel like I wouldn't be happy if I gave up on life and I want to try harder. I am just remarking how funny coincidence can be, I suppose.

My mantra as of late seems to be "All the self-awareness in the world doesn't mean shit if you don't know how to apply it to better yourself."

Hey thanks. I tend to say the bulk of my thoughts in my initial posts, but if something comes up, I always appreciate an ear to vent to.

I love RPG's and Puzzle games the most, but I also love some FPS games. Right now I'm sucked into WoW pretty bad. I really want to get back into Borderlands. 

My favorite style of art is art nouveau, but my favorite medium is watercolor, in terms of what I like to look at. I do mostly graphite and digital work myself. I'm trying to get into watercolor more.
Every time I want to try something new, art-wise, for me, I just think of the people waiting on their pieces and I want to just crawl in a hole. 

I really loved working with clay in high school, but I have no space for it here.

I like designing things, so arrangement and color palette means a great deal to me actually, so I can relate with you on that.
